description:
An alien giant rises out of a harbor city. The army opens fire — and loses.

But the giant is not the invader. It is a prisoner, sent to Earth on a leash by the Keepers — alien herders who collect whole worlds the way others collect cattle.

On Earth, the corporation AEGIS has leashes of its own. Director Silas Roarke commands an army of cybernetic animals through collars that run on pain: a rhino rebuilt as a living battering ram, a wolf with steel claws, an owl with blade feathers.

Three days ago they were taken from a small seaside rescue sanctuary. June was there when it burned.

Now she holds the one thing Roarke wants: Ember, a tiny fox who carries the Tether — living armor that grows on whoever the animals trust — and the key that can break every collar.

To free the mech-beasts, June must face AEGIS, a monster stitched together from every animal that failed the collar, and the Keepers themselves.

And to stop the giant, she has to learn its name.

WILDGUARD combines robot animals, living armor, alien giants, kaiju battles, a ruthless corporation and a team of unlikely guardians fighting for creatures no one else would save.

Watch until the final scene. The giant is free — but the Keepers are not finished with Earth.

Which mech-beast would you want on your team: Bastion, Tripp, Vesper or Ember?
